title: Sourcing from China for USA Buyers
short: Product sourcing, inspection and freight from China to the United States.
intro: American importers and Amazon sellers use Global Grabz to find reliable Chinese factories, inspect goods and ship to US ports or directly to FBA warehouses. We prepare the export documents your US customs broker needs for clearance.
gateways: Los Angeles and Long Beach seaports
New York and New Jersey seaport
points: Amazon FBA prep and direct shipping
Commercial invoice and packing list support
Air and sea options to the US East and West coast
Product labeling checks for US retail
Duty and tariff questions are confirmed with your customs broker

faq.q: Can you ship from China to the USA?
faq.a: Yes. We arrange air and sea freight from China to major US gateways and to Amazon FBA warehouses.
A licensed customs broker in the USA normally files the entry. We prepare the export documents and coordinate with your broker.

title: Sourcing from China for European Buyers
short: Sourcing, inspection and shipping from China to the EU and the United Kingdom.
intro: European importers, retailers and online sellers source with us from Chinese factories and receive goods at European ports and airports. We help with product labeling checks such as CE marking requirements and share the documents your customs agent needs.
points: Air and sea freight to EU and UK gateways
CE marking and labeling checks with the factory
Commercial invoice and packing list support
Rail freight options on selected routes
VAT and duty questions are handled with your local customs agent

faq.q: Do you ship to the UK and the EU?
faq.a: Yes. We ship to major European gateways including the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium and the United Kingdom.

faq.q: Can I source CE marked products?
faq.a: We ask factories for certificates and test reports. You should confirm the final compliance requirements for your product and country.

title: Sourcing from China for Australian Buyers
short: Sourcing, inspection and sea or air freight from China to Australia.

faq.q: Can you ship small orders to Australia?
